purpose: Measure native guard order counts and verify queue preservation plus immediate recovery after STOP, target change, movement and target destruction.
limitations: Supplied fixture re-admits real guard tasks and exempts its owned guards from SEA idle-assist cleanup; it is not normal role frequency evidence.
STOP and MOVE use the existing AI command API; spectator LuaUI orders would be rejected. STOP is timed from its synchronized event, and moving-target acceptance requires actual displacement.
Natural runs preserve role policy and fog, but diverging game populations cannot prove an FPS percentage.
CIRCUIT_VERIFY_GUARD enables extra diagnostic reads/logging, unsuitable for CPU timing.
Local synchronized order counts are not internet packet measurements.
